plainTranslation: The Saturn person can feel like pressure on the Sun person's identity: critique, limits, timing, duty. The Sun person may either mature through the contact or start dimming themselves to avoid disapproval. The difference is consent, warmth, and whether correction is balanced by respect.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Their standards, caution, and sense of responsibility press against your sense of self, confidence, and direction. It catches often enough that you both feel it, and it keeps asking to be worked out. Name it directly instead of letting it build in silence.
tension: At its worst, the lesson gets distorted. You keep trying to prove yourself. They keep finding flaws. Instead of learning responsibility, you learn self-doubt. Instead of building confidence, you become preoccupied with what is wrong with you. The question is whether the challenge is teaching you to trust yourself more or less.
advice: A healthy Sun-Saturn square helps you develop strength, accountability, and self-respect. An unhealthy one leaves you believing that no matter what you do, you will never be enough.
summaryShort: Their standards, caution, and sense of responsibility press against your sense of self, confidence, and direction.
